SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mingle_users WHERE created_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS newUsersToday,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mingle_support_tickets WHERE status = 'PENDING') AS pendingTickets,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mingle_reports WHERE status = 'PENDING') AS pendingReports,
(SELECT NVL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM mingle_payments WHERE status = 'PAID' AND paid_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS todaySalesAmount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mingle_payments WHERE status = 'PAID' AND paid_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS todayPaymentCount,
(SELECT NVL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM mingle_payments WHERE status = 'PAID' AND paid_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')) AS monthSalesAmount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mingle_payments WHERE status = 'PAID' AND paid_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')) AS monthPaymentCount FROM dual
